description: Intake directory of every ACTIVE 'monetize' marketplace: one row per marketplace exposing marketplace_name plus the working context ids (agency_id, marketplace_client_id) and settings (region, currency, timezone). CROSS-TENANT (no agency scope) so the app can fuzzy-match a user's typed marketplace name against these names and then use the matched row's ids/region/currency/timezone as session context. No real metrics — a placeholder_metric is included to satisfy the fetch layer.

marketplace_name.description: Human-readable marketplace/agency name (fuzzy-matched against the user's input).

agency_id.description: Agency id for this marketplace — the tenant scope used by all downstream reports (exposed here because this is the intake directory that bootstraps a session).

marketplace_client_id.description: Marketplace client id for this marketplace, used as the working id for problem-metric and breakdown lookups.

region.description: Region of the marketplace (drives the region-specific reporting dataset).

currency.description: Reporting currency for the marketplace (prefix monetary values with this).

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the marketplace (drives timezone-aware date casts).

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0 — a required placeholder metric so the fetch layer accepts this pure-attribute directory report; not a real measure.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.agencies` AS a JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.marketplace_client_id = a.marketplace_client_id WHERE LOWER(a.name) NOT LIKE '%staging%' AND LOWER(a.name) NOT LIKE '%sandbox%' AND a.status_type = 'ACTIVE' AND a.marketplace_type = 'monetize' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
